**銅製裝備的其他版本** [![僅工具圖示](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fef0a6f2fc634ae51ea294190e28a9ef653a44d4_0.webp)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/coppered-equipment/version/irQ1JVCX) [![僅盔甲圖示](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a814a5a071e5546ceb78c3021c673493c9d9cbf_0.webp)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/coppered-equipment/version/RAQ5y5yl) [![經典銅製裝備](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2eb7bc4d51b4ff7136fbbaf94bd5ed018fe2717d_0.webp)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/coppered-equipment/version/42IDtNNt)
________________________________________________________________________________________________ **銅製工具**
銅鎬 ![銅鎬氧化過程](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/22eef4e5130daf92104596800ab88f55b2bbc8b6.png)
銅製工具的全新外觀。工具主體以閃亮的橙銅色起始，手柄處則呈現氧化銅的藍綠色調，將工具部件緊密結合。隨著銅製工具耐久度降低，氧化程度會逐漸加深！這為工具損耗狀態提供了絕佳的視覺提示。
**銅製盔甲**
銅製盔甲 ![銅製盔甲](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/778684da3c9d357b97544534c7637296e6beb939.png) ![銅製馬鎧](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a43d3db611207eedb658a0ea7927e621f3991cc.png)
銅製盔甲並非簡單重製現有金屬盔甲紋理，其設計靈感源自銅箱的獨特造型！盔甲整體保持閃亮的橙銅色澤，確保不會與盔甲飾邊產生視覺衝突
